profile.title: Profile

education.label: Education
education.value: Mimar Sinan Fine Arts University Urban Planning Master's, 2018

profile.aboutDesc: I am a multidisciplinary Full Stack Developer and UX/UI Designer with a background in Urban Planning. My interest in software development was a natural extension of my experience as a Co-Founder of a civic-tech focused non-profit, where I navigated the challenges of building an organization from the ground up—from legal foundation to digital infrastructure. I spearheaded the digital transformation of our advocacy tools and internal management systems, realizing the immense power of technology in scaling impact. Today, I combine this entrepreneurial mindset and spatial analysis expertise with modern tech stacks like React Native, Expo, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. I am dedicated to building high-impact, data-driven applications that streamline complex workflows and deliver intuitive user experiences.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A selection of projects I've worked on so far. Use the tabs to explore what I built, the challenges I faced, and what I learned from each experience.

items.title: Personal Website
items.subtitle: Portfolio & personal branding website
features: Single-page portfolio with smooth scrolling layout.
Dark/Light mode toggle with local storage.
Multi-language support (TR / EN) with dynamic content.
challenges: Designing a layout that works well on all screen sizes.
Keeping the design minimal while still showing enough information.
learnings: Improved skills in responsive UI design.
Learned how to organize content for personal branding.

items.title: PDF Expense to Excel Automation
items.subtitle: Desktop app: bank & card statement PDFs → cumulative Excel
features: Reads checking-account and credit-card statement PDFs and appends rows to a single running Excel workbook.
Desktop GUI to pick PDFs, output path, category rules (`rules.yaml`), and processed-files history.
Keyword-based categorization via YAML rules with a sensible default for unmatched merchants.
Optional macOS `.app` packaging so the tool runs without a separate Python install.
challenges: Handling two different bank PDF layouts and keeping parsing resilient to small format changes.
Turning noisy PDF text into clean, consistent rows for Excel.
learnings: Practical PDF text extraction and normalization with Python.
Shipping a small automation as a usable desktop app with clear file inputs and outputs.

items.title: Eldes Website
items.subtitle: Corporate marketing website
features: Marketing-focused landing pages for product and solutions.
Reusable component structure for sections and call-to-actions.
SEO-friendly, accessible and fast-loading pages.
challenges: Balancing corporate brand guidelines with modern UI patterns.
Managing content-heavy sections without overwhelming the user.
learnings: Experience working with real product copy and brand rules.
Stronger understanding of typography and spacing in marketing sites.

items.title: E-commerce Web App
items.subtitle: Modern online store experience
features: Product listing and detail pages optimized for conversions.
Shopping cart and checkout flow designed for a smooth experience.
Responsive layout that works well across mobile and desktop.
challenges: Designing flows that stay simple while handling many edge cases.
Keeping performance high even with image-heavy pages.
learnings: Deeper understanding of e-commerce UX patterns.
Improved skills in structuring data-heavy interfaces.

items.title: B-Management Mobile Development
items.subtitle: Mobile app for construction / project management
items.disclaimer: Disclaimer: Project development is currently suspended by the owner. Limited data and documentation are provided here to maintain confidentiality while showcasing the mobile architecture.
items.description: A comprehensive mobile application developed for the construction industry to streamline project management and resource tracking. I led the mobile development process from scratch, taking the product from a web-only service to a fully functional mobile experience ready for the global market.
features: Mobile-first flows for managing tasks and project data.
Simple, focused navigation optimized for on-the-go usage.
Reusable UI components shared across multiple screens.
challenges: Designing flows that are easy to use in the field.
Adapting layouts to different mobile screen sizes, from an existing web application.
learnings: Gained experience in mobile design patterns and navigation.
Improved thinking about offline / low-connection scenarios.

items.title: W-Network Mobile Development
items.subtitle: Mobile app for HR / work management
items.disclaimer: Disclaimer: Project development is currently suspended by the owner. Limited data and documentation are provided here to maintain confidentiality while showcasing the mobile architecture.
items.description: The mobile counterpart of a professional networking and job matching platform. My role was to translate the core web functionalities into a seamless, high-performance mobile app focused on user engagement and real-time communication.
features: Screens for managing jobs, candidates, and workflows.
Clean UI with clear hierarchy for dense information.
Global state management tuned for mobile performance.
challenges: Presenting a lot of data without cluttering the screen.
Keeping interactions quick and simple for busy users.
learnings: Deeper understanding of state management in mobile apps.
Experience designing for productivity-focused tools.

profile.title: Profil

education.label: Eğitim
education.value: Mimar Sinan Güzel Sanatlar Üniversitesi Şehir Planlama Yüksek Lisansı, 2018

profile.aboutDesc: Mekansal tasarım ve kullanıcı deneyimi alanındaki geçmişimi, bugün yenilikçi ve kullanıcı odaklı çözümler üreten bir Full Stack Developer kimliğiyle birleştiriyorum. Yazılıma olan ilgim, kurucu ortağı olduğum hak temelli bir sivil toplum kuruluşunun tüm kuruluş ve dijital altyapı süreçlerini yönetirken şekillendi. Bir nevi 'civic-tech start-up' mantığıyla ilerlediğimiz bu süreçte; idari işleyişten savunuculuk araçlarına kadar tüm operasyonu dijitale taşıyarak teknolojinin ölçeklenebilir etkisini bizzat deneyimledim. Bu girişimci bakış açısını; JavaScript, React Native, Expo ve Node.js gibi modern teknolojilerle birleştirerek karmaşık ihtiyaçları zarif ve etkili dijital ürünlere dönüştürüyorum. Veri odaklı, temiz kod prensiplerine sahip ve kullanıcıyı merkeze alan uygulamalar geliştirmeye odaklanıyorum.

items.title: PDF Harcama → Excel Otomasyonu
items.subtitle: Masaüstü uygulama: banka ve kart ekstre PDF'lerinden birikimli Excel
features: Vadesiz hesap özeti ve kredi kartı ekstresi PDF'lerini okuyup tek bir Excel dosyasına satır satır ekler.
PDF seçimi, çıktı yolu, kategori kuralları (`rules.yaml`) ve işlenen dosya geçmişi için masaüstü arayüz.
YAML kurallarıyla anahtar kelime tabanlı kategori; eşleşme yoksa varsayılan kategori.
İsteğe bağlı macOS `.app` paketleme; ayrı Python kurulumu gerektirmeden çalıştırma.
challenges: İki farklı banka PDF düzenini desteklemek ve küçük format farklarına karşı parse mantığını dayanıklı tutmak.
Gürültülü PDF metnini Excel için tutarlı satırlara dönüştürmek.
learnings: Python ile pratik PDF metin çıkarma ve normalizasyon.
Net dosya girdisi/çıktısı olan küçük bir otomasyonu kullanılabilir masaüstü uygulaması olarak sunmak.

Sahada kullanıma uygun sade ve odaklı gezinme.
Birden fazla ekranda paylaşılan yeniden kullanılabilir bileşenler.
challenges: Sahada kolay kullanılabilen akışlar tasarlamak.
Mevcut web uygulamasından farklı mobil ekran boyutlarına uyum sağlamak.
learnings: Mobil tasarım kalıpları ve gezinme konusunda deneyim.
Çevrimdışı / düşük bağlantı senaryolarını düşünme.
